entities.summary: Saint Mary's Royal Church is a Catholic parish church located on the Place de la Reine/Koninginneplein in Schaerbeek, a municipality of Brussels, Belgium. Officially dedicated to Our Lady of the Assumption, it is popularly associated with Queen Louise-Marie, first Queen of the Belgians, as is the square where it is located, which earned it the title of "Royal". St. Mary's Royal Church is a church building in Europe, established in 1844. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
